name: Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd
summary: Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd is a provider of solar cells and photovoltaic modules. Their product portfolio encompasses various PV module types, including monofacial, bifacial, and shingled designs. They also supply both transformer-less and outdoor box inverters. Beyond individual components, the firm delivers complete PV solutions for ground, floating, and agricultural installations, as well as smart solar city projects. This company was established in 2004 and has its headquarters in Seongnam, South Korea.
